new_source_notes.claim: Janson prints s0'=25;9,20,0,97440 (radices27,60,60,6,149209) and also s0'=1−458772/6714405. Exact conversion of the first equals 1−458672/6714405, matching Henning p63. The published rational fraction differs by 100/6714405 full circle (~19.3 arcseconds), so the two values cannot both denote the same epoch longitude.

correction_policy: Do not silently modify author literal text; computation supports an explicit author-literal variant and a separate manuscript/mixed-radix/Henning-supported variant. Prefer source agreement as *working* code hypothesis, not declared provenance-resolved Sanskrit original.
